This small plot near my home has always been for enset and root crops to feed my family. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for it — I save my money for DAP and urea on the cereal fields where it matters more. We spread manure and compost here, and my family handles all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without hiring outsiders.
